description: This PHP class implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide a formatted string for a project activity entity, using the TimesheetService to retrieve activity details by ID.

classes.name: FormatWithActivity
classes.description: A class that formats an entity value into the corresponding activity name, using a timesheet service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity associated with the provided activity ID, or null if not found.
